findings.evidence: `Classification.lean:329-331,337-339,343-345,349-351`; `mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Defs.lean:56` `def Matrix (m n α) : Type _ := m → n → α` with the implementation note at lines 40-45 ("not advisable"), and `Matrix.ext_iff` at line 69; `Matrix.submatrix_apply` is already used as a rewrite elsewhere in this same file (e.g. line 91).
findings.fix: Add one private helper and make all four proofs one line each: `private lemma starHasCartanType_of_eq_submatrix {t : DynkinType} (e : StarIndex ℓ ≃ Fin t.rank) (h : starCartanMatrix ℓ = t.cartanMatrix.submatrix e e) : StarHasCartanType ℓ t := ⟨e, fun v w ↦ by rw [h, Matrix.submatrix_apply]⟩`, then e.g. `exact starHasCartanType_of_eq_submatrix (starIndexEquivD c) (by simpa using starCartanMatrix_one_one_eq_submatrix_D c)`. This also removes the four-fold repetition of the `refine … ; simp only [cartanMatrix_X] ; exact congrFun …` pattern.
findings.issue: `exact congrFun (congrFun (starCartanMatrix_one_one_eq_submatrix_D c) v) w` applies `congrFun` to an equality of `Matrix _ _ ℤ`, which only elaborates by unfolding `Matrix m n α := m → n → α`, and then closes the goal by a second undocumented defeq (`(A.submatrix e e) v w` vs `A (e v) (e w)`, i.e. unfolding `Matrix.submatrix` and `Matrix.of`). Same at lines 339 (E6), 345 (E7), 351 (E8). Mathlib's `Matrix` docstring explicitly discourages this pi-type view and supplies `Matrix.ext_iff` / `Matrix.submatrix_apply` instead.

summary: Proofs are automation-based, free of `change`/`show`, and the earlier `▸` casts and unused conjunct are gone. The four headline identifications still derive their entrywise statement from a matrix-level equation by treating `Matrix` as a pi type and `submatrix` as its unfolding, twice-undocumented definitional equality that a one-line helper lemma removes.
